keyVerseDR: "...blessed are they that have not seen and have believed." (Jn 20:29)

level1.title: Thomas Believes
level1.story: Jesus came to His friends and said, "Peace be with you!" Thomas was not there and did not believe. Eight days later, Jesus showed Thomas His hands, and Thomas believed.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How do you know Jesus loves you?
level1.prayer: Jesus, I trust in You. Amen.

level2.title: Peace Be With You
level2.story: On the evening of Easter, Jesus came to the disciples behind shut doors and said, "Peace be to you." He showed them His hands and side, and they were glad. He breathed on them and said, "Receive ye the Holy Ghost." Thomas was not there and said, "Except I shall see in His hands the print of the nails... I will not believe." Eight days later Jesus came and Thomas said, "My Lord, and my God," and Jesus said, "Blessed are they that have not seen, and have believed."
level2.keyLine: Blessed are they that have not seen and have believed.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
